purpose: Original 16-bit pixel-art UV atlas for low-poly console models and environments
layout: 4 columns x 2 rows: walnut wall, oak floor, teal carpet, neutral ABS; CRT scene, original poster, moonlit window, amber marquee
prompt: Production-ready square flat UV texture atlas, strict 4x2 equal cells without gaps; crisp 16-bit console pixel art, restrained colors, no antialiasing, no text/logos/copyrighted game imagery. Quiet top-row materials, original geometric lower-row decoration; orthographic bitmap, not perspective concept art. See docs/ART-DIRECTION-POLISH.md for the complete prompt.
normalization: Blender 5.2 nearest 512x512 sampling; RGB565 color grid; PNG storage. Runtime uses GL_NEAREST/CLAMP_TO_EDGE.
rights: Original AI-assisted artwork created for this project; no third-party bitmap samples or logos. No assertion of exclusive rights to AI-generated output.

current_runtime_override.method: Nearest 512x512, RGB565, same 4x2 UV slots; historical original source.png retained
